verdict.rationale: BugSnag's grouping docs say grouping shows which issues have the biggest impact on users, and a community user praises being able to track how many users a particular bug affects. Session-level impact is documented only as a project-wide stability metric (proportion of error-free sessions), not as a per-issue count. Missing for 10: documented per-issue affected-user and affected-session counts, sorting or prioritizing issues by user/session impact rather than event count, and recent independent corroboration (the community evidence is old).
